name: ecommerce-tax-livewire
description: The shopper-facing Livewire surface for tax: a breakdown of what was charged, and an exemption claim that fails closed.
features: A tax breakdown rendered from a quote, in the settled money envelope
An exemption claim that refuses and charges tax when validation fails
Loading, empty, unauthorised and failure states for every action
Expiry and supersession rendered as their own states, never recalculated
No rate, jurisdiction or registration footprint is ever disclosed to a shopper
One idempotency key per claim, minted when the step is entered
Every public property locked, so nothing on the surface is a client input
